title: Quietly Steamed Korean Lamb Wrap
description: A traditional Korean dish featuring lamb leg, steamed in a leaf wrap, perfect for a hangover cure. This resinous and shattering dish is a Seoul favorite.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chili flakes, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Add the lamb leg to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water, and cut the lotus leaves into large squares.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and place it in the center of each lotus leaf square.
Brush the edges of the leaves with sesame oil, then fold the leaves over the lamb to form a tight packet.
Place the packets in the steamer basket, cover, and steam for 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb wraps hot, garnished with additional chili flakes and soy sauce if desired.
Let the packets rest for 2 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
